steps.name: To Change the Future
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」.

steps.name: A Girl's Memories
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」, then view someone's memories and return.
2. Turn in the quest to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」.

lines.text: (As %s recounts what happened in Esnil's Other Side, Iris's expression gradually grows tense.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After seeing that future, I have to go...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Iris... Why couldn't a Spirit King like Sylphid learn anything about Glaston?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Someone is deliberately preventing information about what happens inside from getting out.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A being with the powerful, ominous presence in that vision could certainly do it...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If I were just a little stronger, I might have noticed sooner...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, this must have started before you ever left Belos. None of it is your fault.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I keep sounding so helpless... I want to put an end to this cycle...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: These things have always happened.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The moment someone turns a misguided belief into an unshakable conviction, countless lives suffer.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The Chimera Laboratory's work sank Atlantis beneath the sea. Ban and Mara killed so many living beings to create magic stones.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Weiss tried to destroy Etoile simply to save his own world.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And now there are mages trying to create a new god for a world they believe has none.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And the witches...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something you must understand, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Not every god is like Seres or Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...
(Iris takes both hands of %s, who is biting their lip.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When I learned Empress Kaina could see the gaps in the Great Wall, I suspected... But I hoped I was wrong.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Some people must accept a fate they could never have imagined.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Perhaps Her Majesty could no longer bear it alone, and told her sister and you, %s, to ask for help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I have to go to Glaston. Her Majesty's visions have never been wrong. That frightens me a little.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It will be all right.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I haven't told you. Many of the futures Her Majesty saw were grim. But little by little, they've changed for the better.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I can't be certain, but your efforts seem to be gradually stabilizing the Great Wall, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I couldn't trust feelings like that before. But now I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll do whatever I can to change the future Her Majesty and I saw.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This will be more dangerous than anything before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. You're always behind me, Iris. It'll be all right.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you, %s... Oh, wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There's something I want to show you. Someone's memory, carried through a gap in the Great Wall...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A memory?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know whose it is. But I know one thing: it takes place in Glaston.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I only understood after hearing your story, %s. Information from Glaston, which was beyond our reach, is now coming to us...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Something there is calling us to Glaston.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me see it first, then decide. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I see this memory?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Close your eyes for a moment. I'll bring it into your mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.
(Light slips through the soft darkness behind closed eyes. It unfolds someone else's memory, in a strange place never seen before.)
Haah... Haah...
I have to get out. I have to...
(A little girl stops after struggling through a dry waterway. She nibbles anxiously at a fingernail.)
Ugh...
(As though making up her mind, she raises her head and opens the umbrella in her hand.)
(Her animal-like ears twitch as she braces to charge, using the umbrella as a shield.)
One, two, three!
(On three, she rushes forward, only to hit something and bounce back.)
Thud.
Ow... Again! One, two, three!
(The girl keeps running toward what appears to be the exit. Each attempt ends the same way.)
(The invisible wall blocking her pushes her back inside with even greater force.)
Thud.
I want to leave. I want to get out! Why won't you let me?
No Name got out, so I should be able to! Why am I the only one who can't leave? I want to go...
I'm going to leave. I, Atalante, am getting out! I have to see Mommy. I miss her!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Mommy... Mommy...
(Sobbing, the girl keeps rushing toward the exit, only to end up where she began. Elsewhere in that ominous place, a mage arrives, searching for something.)

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: ...Haah. I came as ordered, but there's no way it could be here—
(Just then, he sees Atalante thrown backward ahead of him.)

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: ...N-no. It can't be...
(Seeing Atalante on the ground, the mage backs away, then carefully walks back the way he came.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: M-mister!
(Atalante spots the mage and runs toward him.)

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: D-don't come near me!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Mister! You know me, don't you? It's me! Let me out!
(The terrified mage runs desperately, but Atalante catches up. After several attempts to escape, he ends up cornered in a dead end.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Mister Mage... Please, help me. You can get out, can't you? I have to leave. I have to see Mommy... Please...

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: Wh-why are you doing this to me...? I... I only did what I was told...
(At his words, the tearful Atalante goes still. Her trembling eyes stop moving and fix on him.)

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: ...Atalante? W-wait. Hear me out... Atalante... ?
(The terrified mage's reflection fills Atalante's clear eyes...)
(...And as darkness returns, a scream echoes through the place.)

steps.name: Preparing to Visit the Capital
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」, then go to [Dayna] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.
2. Turn in the quest to [Narsha] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You can open your eyes now, %s.
(Iris gently takes the speechless %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Iris...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is that child? Why is she there? I think she said her name was Atalante...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But one thing is certain... The mage said something when he saw her, and I couldn't hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You couldn't either? Could it have been a god's name?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Perhaps it was the name of someone I don't know.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think her presence there has something to do with the Magic Bureau. She knows No Name, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could they be keeping her as a key, like when Weiss summoned Deimos... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go to Glaston. I need to investigate so you can prepare, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you ever been there?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No. I've only heard the name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... How will I get there this time? I'll have to find someone who can help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everything will be all right, Iris. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: All right. Take care...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Iris.
(Dayna, deep in thought with her eyes closed, senses someone approaching and looks up.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s... I told you to rest. Where have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought Iris needed to know what was happening.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Are you heading to Glaston now? It isn't time yet... Have you learned something new?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...
(As %s hesitates, Iris's voice reaches their ear.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: You may tell the princess.
(Sensing something, Dayna looks around.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, did the goddess just visit?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not in person. She said I could tell you what I saw.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Dayna what Iris and I discussed and saw, from the barrier keeping Glaston's secrets from Iris and the spirits to the girl in the underground waterway.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So that's why. Now I understand...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean, Dayna?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The Other Side is hard to find, but it's always existed beside people.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's present in places few people visit, like Eidos Sanctuary, and in large towns like Esnil...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But I've never found it in Glaston, the largest city on the continent.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If a being on Iris's level was blocking information, that would certainly explain it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That makes sense. Hmm... Do you know where that underground waterway might be?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Glaston's underground waterways are vast. I couldn't pinpoint the location.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: When the kingdom became an empire centuries ago, they planned the city, including its drainage system. It's still being maintained today...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But I believe they abandon waterways that are too badly damaged to repair.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's useful information, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Everyone from Glaston knows it, so I'm not sure I'd call it useful. The question is where to start looking...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Glaston is no ordinary city. Finding the place in that memory could take a very long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leave that to me. I'll go ahead and find a way.
(Dayna looks a little surprised by %s's resolve, then smiles quietly.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you, %s. ...You've changed a lot. When we first met, you seemed weighed down by so much...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It isn't time yet, but I have something in mind. I should get moving, too. It'll only be a few days, but I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You don't know the way to Glaston, do you? Narsha does. Go with her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Wait, with her?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The Magic Bureau regularly inspects Narsha's magic golem. Her next visit happens to be due now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will that be all right... ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Stopping her from going would only raise suspicion. As long as the Bureau's mages are studying the golem, they won't harm its owner.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Besides, Narsha has plenty of people behind her. They know that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: She'll be happy to have you along, %s. Go on.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And when you reach Glaston's central square, look for Silvia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silvia? Who's that?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Argent's younger sister. She looks like him, so you'll recognize her. Tell her I sent you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dayna. See you later.

steps.name: Onward to Glaston
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Narsha] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」, then find [Leon] on 「Laran Road」.
2. After talking to [Leon], go to 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」 and turn in the quest to [Narsha].

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And then the wicked fairy met the golem...
(Narsha is reading the book she found some time ago. She is so absorbed that she seems unaware of anyone approaching.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Enjoying the book?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's all right. Oh...? Hello, %s!
(Recognizing the adventurer, Narsha stands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hear you're going to Glaston soon.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: How did you know? Oh, the President told you. I'm going to the Magic Bureau for Madori's inspection.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to go to Glaston, too, but I don't know the way. Dayna suggested I go with you.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wow, really? Raclette and Jelic said they couldn't come this time. I wondered who would. And it's you!
(Narsha looks rather pleased.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you were visiting the Magic Bureau...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Don't worry. We don't do anything particularly unusual there. It'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I just speak briefly with a mage, and he checks Madori's condition.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How does he check it?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I ask Madori to do things and see whether it follows along. Raise your arm. Roll forward. Jump a little. Dance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds simple enough.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Raven, the mage in charge, says even he doesn't know why we do it. Oh, he's the one who checks Madori.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Hmm... When are you planning to leave?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: As soon as I put this book away. Wait just a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'll be here.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You didn't. Shall we go? I haven't seen that outfit in a while.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I felt like I should wear it this time. What do you think? Does it look strange?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It suits you. You still like the outfit Minos gave you, don't you?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I do, and it makes me feel stronger. I like it even more because it was a gift from someone like me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'd love to visit Minos again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go together sometime. He'd be happy to see you.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Promise you'll take me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, when we go to Knossos... I hope we don't see that strange man.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... All right. He makes me a little uncomfortable, too...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hehe. We think alike, don't we?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: To get to Glaston, we can head straight up the Laran Road near Luria Village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, was there a path there?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You know the saying: whichever road you take, all that matters is reaching Glaston. There are that many ways to get there.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And Raven told me to make sure we walk. Something about getting accurate measurements... I've done it several times, but I still don't understand why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you visited the Magic Bureau since returning from Orcarium?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: No. They did ask me to come once, but the President thought it was suspicious and declined for me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: She said, 'So this is another use for my authority as a princess.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An unexpected summons... Hmm...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Shall we see Mister Leon when we reach the Laran Road? He chases the Hefrings off the path for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Leon, too?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: So do you, I see.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Our situations are different, but a little alike. Leon is fully one of the beastfolk, and people sometimes call me beastfolk, too...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: We became friends after meeting on my trips to Glaston. He's really funny.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He is. So funny he's a little strange... Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Shall we go? I've been dawdling, haven't I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh! Narsa? Narsa, it's been ages! And hello, hello to %s, owner of the Chamber of the Great %s!
(While chasing Hefrings away from his lunchbox, Leon notices %s and Narsha approaching and waves.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Mister Leon, I've told you before. My name is Narsha, not Narsa.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Right, Naru-Naru. And don't call me Mister. I'm only twenty.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Not Naru-Naru. Narsha... Haah. I'd half given up, but I suppose I should give up completely.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Hehe. I win, Narsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Same old Leon. But how do you know the room's name?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: What room? The Chamber of the Great %s? The Chamber of the Great and Magnificent %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aagh, stop making such a fuss about that name!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I heard the lodgings at the Nereis Gateway Center had a peculiar name. How did yours end up on them, %s?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Granny Helena told me. Her Majesty personally named the room so %s could rest there whenever they visited.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, Her Majesty did...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: An excellent choice, as expected.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: You think so too, Narulong? We really do get along. Off to Glaston again today?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes. %s is coming with me today.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Lucky you. I've never been to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Even when I get there, there are hardly any places I'm allowed to go. Just the Magic Bureau, really...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh... Sorry.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Why are you apologizing, Leon?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I'm sorry, Narsha. I had a stupid thought: she gets to visit places I've never been.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's all right. I do get to visit the Magic Bureau, and you don't. So don't call yourself stupid. Unless you are a little stupid?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Thanks. I appreciate it, but... Now you really are calling me stupid.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hehe. Silly Leon.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Hehe. Silly Narulongsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nice seeing how close you two are.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Hehe. Silly %s?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Kidding, kidding. I'll chase away the Hefrings that beg for food on the road to Glaston. Take good care of Narsha, all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thank you, Leon.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thanks, Leon. I'll bring you the chocolate you wanted on my way back.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh, really? I'll be waiting, Narsha! Goodbye, %s. Time to chase some Hefrings!
(With that, Leon goes after the Hefrings rushing in for food.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The road to Glaston is over there. Follow me. Wait... Is it all right for Leon to eat chocolate?

steps.name: LaChouette's Wish
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Narsha] in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」, then go to [Daisy].
2. After talking to [Daisy], go up to 「Glaston Central Plaza」 and turn in the quest to [Moran].

lines.text: (The castle, towering high enough to be seen from afar, draws closer. But the street where they stop feels very different from that distant grandeur.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is Glaston. See the castle over there? That's Her Majesty's imperial palace.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The tall buildings below it are the government offices in the administrative district. Below those is the central square.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And this is...
(Narsha trails off and bows her head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Um... Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you're trying to say. I'm all right. Don't worry about me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing has happened yet.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh...
(Narsha quietly nods in understanding.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'll be at the inn just ahead. That's where I stay when I come to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: While I'm resting, Raven sends someone for me. I go with them, then come back. That's all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As Narsha says, it doesn't sound dangerous, but...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Don't worry too much. There are people in Glaston like the President, Jelic, and Raclette. They can help me get home, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those people? Oh, then it should be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, you knew what they do?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Not the details. I just know they do something a little special.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What will you do now? You said you had business here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll visit the person Dayna introduced me to.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Take care, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: See you later! Thank you.
(Narsha says goodbye to %s and heads toward what appears to be her lodgings.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha... You must have had so many questions...
(Only after Narsha leaves does %s take in the street around them.)
(Unlike the clean northern district and its magnificent castle, the street where the adventurer stands has a very different atmosphere.)
(Old, shabby buildings. Poorly maintained roads. Broken signs, carts, and shattered bottles.)
(Laundry hangs on makeshift lines strung between the buildings.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like a country village... Though with this many people, it's clearly a city. Plenty of vendors, and children running everywhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which way is the square... ?
(A girl carrying a guitar looks around in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe I should ask her.
(As the adventurer approaches, the girl with the guitar greets them with a bright smile.)
If you've brought a gift, the thought is enough. But a heartfelt letter is always welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A gift? A letter? I just wanted to ask...
Oh! Ahahaha, you're not a fan. I assumed you'd come to give me something.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Hello! I'm Daisy. Just call me Daisy. No need to be formal!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: And it's fine if you're not a fan. Ask me anything!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I love answering questions. But if you ask anything cheeky, I'll whack you with my guitar!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What...? Oh. All right.
(The girl who introduced herself as Daisy lifts her guitar with a dazzling smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get to the central square?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Oh, so you weren't curious about me. That's fine. To reach the square, follow the road behind me straight up. All the way up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Daisy.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I'll have to work harder. If this many people still don't recognize me, I have a long way to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, Daisy. Next time, I'll say hello first.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: That's kind of you. Hehe. I'll keep trying.
Daisy, I'll escort this visitor.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Thanks, Moran. I appreciate it.
(A sturdy young man carrying a large broom nods in greeting.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: A pleasure to meet you. I'm Moran, a caretaker with the Square Maintenance Department. If you have any identification, I may be able to help further...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, of course. Here...

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: An imperial authorization card. %s? Ah!

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: You're the one who led us to victory at Moros. It's an honor to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's good to meet you, too, Moran. How did you know about me?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: You're well known among those of us who work for the government. I believe ordinary citizens know you, too.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I've finished cleaning LaChouette and was about to return to the square. Good timing. Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Moran. And thank you, Daisy.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Of course. It's my job. Oh, Daisy, a word before I go.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: You know you need a permit from the department for street performances, too?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I brought the paperwork and got one. Look. But why was this in the forms?
(Daisy takes what appears to be a permit from her guitar case and shows Moran.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: ...Sorry. I didn't know they'd included a pledge not to feed the pigeons. Though perhaps it's because of your past record?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Ahaha... I only gave them a little... And Ratsy took it all anyway...

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: All right, all right. Don't sing late into the night like last time. Head home before sunset. Even if the neighbors enjoy your music, don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: But I want to see the merry owls come out to play. What a shame.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I know you sing for LaChouette, but you could end up making things harder for it.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: At worst, people might start calling for a ban on street performances here, too.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I'll remember, Moran.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, you can't perform in places like the square?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: The council recently claimed it caused too much noise. Now performances in the square and all large shows are banned.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: We have an outdoor theater that holds thousands, and an opera house, too...

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I doubt noise is the real problem. No one complained when famous performers appeared before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Moran, I know you're busy, but stay for one song. You like my music. %s, you stay for a song too, %s.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Would that be all right, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I enjoy music, too.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: You won't regret it.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Daisy, we'll listen from the back, then head to the square after one song.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Thank you. I'll get ready. Stay right there and watch, okay?
(Daisy beams and skips to the spot she picked out. A crowd has already gathered, calling her name.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Two, three! Hello, everyone! I'm Daisy!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Wow! LaChouette, it's been so long! You haven't forgotten me, have you? It's all right if you have. After today, you'll never forget me again!
You're so pretty!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Have you eaten? Listen to my song, then get yourselves something delicious. Promise!
Promise!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Ah, my opening speech is getting long today. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Here's the first song.
(Daisy raises her pick and gently strums the guitar.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: La Chouette La Vita... ♬
(She has sung only one phrase, but the crowd erupts in cheers.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: La Chouette La Vita... ♬ Eyes open, eyes closed, the merry owl dreams ♪ and sings ♩

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Don't try to lock me in a cage ♬
(The song, gentle at first, grows passionate, making the listeners' hearts beat faster.)
Woooow... I love this. It's incredible...

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Isn't she remarkable? A girl born and raised in LaChouette, still singing without losing hope...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm lucky to hear such a wonderful song on my first visit to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Ah, I don't think we need to stay for the next song.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to hear one more, but shall we go?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Sorry, Daisy, but I'm not fond of the next song's title.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: The next song is [I Entered an Eight-Person Dungeon, My Entire Party Died, and I Was the Only One Left to Face the Boss].

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: If you know it, sing along!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Let's go. The square is that way.
(After rough roads, narrow alleys, and long flights of stairs, they emerge onto a street with an entirely different atmosphere.)
(If LaChouette was the city's shadow, this new district is the sun shining in a morning sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow...
(As though welcoming them, the siren fountain at the center sends jets of water into the air.)
(A rainbow rises beneath the clear sky, arching across the imperial palace.)
(People cross the square on their various errands, filling it with life.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's enormous. Roads here, roads there...

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: That way leads to the palace and administrative district. This way is the residential district and the workshops. And over there...
(Moran explains the square's streets as %s looks around in fascination.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: If you're still unsure, go to the fountain. You can see the paths to the other districts clearly from there.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Following the Rumors in the Square
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Moran] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」, then complete the side quests (The Noble of the Slums) and (Following the Flowers).
2. Once you have gathered all the information, go to the siren statue and review what you have learned. Then turn in the quest to [Silvia] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's so much to see in the central square. I got distracted for a moment.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Haha, that's all right. Everyone reacts that way on their first visit.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Can I help with anything else? You seemed to be looking for something...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone asked me to find a person. I heard she's often in the square...

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I may be able to help if you tell me her name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it was Silvia.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Ah, Silvia. The younger sister of Argent, commander of the imperial knights, the Scar of the Red Moon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: She's a fan of Daisy's, so she was probably in LaChouette. Her work allows her some freedom. I expect she went to watch.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I don't quite have time to fetch her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Moran. I'll find her.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: She works in a government building near the square and often steps outside for a break.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Moran.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Glad to help. Haha. Oh, look at the time.
(Moran takes glasses and a mask from his clothes and puts them on.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: It's time for the square's intensive cleaning, so I should go. Enjoy your time in Glaston, %s.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: If you need help later, come find me, or visit the second-floor office in the Imperial Environment Bureau in the administrative district.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Moran.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's been a while since I met someone so kind...)
(After Moran leaves, %s surveys the square again. The palace high above catches their eye.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's where Her Majesty lives... White, beautiful, and magnificent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The square is lovely, too. It would be nice just to take a walk. But...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That godlike being from the vision is going to appear here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to change that future.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Let's ask around the square. Even small details might add up to something.)
(The area around a siren statue at one side of the square is quiet. With thoughts crowding their mind, %s naturally heads toward it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I should sit down and sort through what I've learned.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A murderer hiding somewhere in LaChouette. A voice from its underground waterways...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No Name seen in a LaChouette alley. A suspicious dolphin. A strange space floating above Glaston... And a Bureau mage who spoke of Pandemonium as though it were nothing...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's use these clues to decide where to go first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now, then...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I only had a glimpse, but LaChouette has so many alleys... How long would it take to search them all?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's still some time, but I don't know if I can check every one. Word of my arrival in Glaston must be spreading by now...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's consider something else...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A place where suspicious things could happen without seeming out of place... The waterways.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The memory Iris showed me was in a waterway. The children heard the voice inside one, too.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know about the other rumors, but I should investigate the waterways first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Before I go, though, I should find someone who can help...)
(As %s thinks, a song reaches their ear. Someone passing by seems to be humming.)
La Chouette La Vita, La Vita~♪

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, what song is that?)
(It is a familiar tune, but the humming is so far off-key and out of rhythm that the original is almost unrecognizable.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Daisy's song!
(At %s's exclamation, the passerby looks around in surprise.)
Yes. It's Daisy's song...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. It sounded so different, I wasn't sure...
(A girl regards the adventurer. Hair red as the sun, blue eyes, an impassive face, and a charming beauty mark in a slightly different spot. She bears a striking resemblance to someone.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silvia?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I am Silvia. Do we know each other?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna said to look for someone who looks unmistakably like Argent...
(Silvia turns her head briefly and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: If the princess... I mean, Dayna, put it that way, I suppose there's nothing I can do. Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's true the Bureau's mages have been involved in everything...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But I don't have enough evidence. I can't go to the Bureau with this alone...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (One wrong move could put Narsha in danger...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's consider something else...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (All this thinking has made me hungry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, Jelic gave Narsha a mountain of food. Perfect timing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ahh, that's better.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now that I've eaten, let's think properly...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now, then...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I only had a glimpse, but LaChouette has so many alleys... How long would searching all of them take?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's still some time, but I don't know if I can check every one. Word of my arrival in Glaston must be spreading by now...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's consider something else...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A place where suspicious things could happen without seeming out of place... The waterways.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The memory Iris showed me was in a waterway. The children heard the voice inside one, too.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know about the other rumors, but the waterways need investigating first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's true the Bureau's mages have been involved in everything...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But I don't have enough evidence. I can't go to the Bureau with this alone...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (One wrong move could put Narsha in danger...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's consider something else...)

steps.name: Argent's Disobedient Younger Sibling
steps.objective: Talk to [Silvia] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」, then turn in the quest to [Narsha] in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」.

lines.text: (At a road leading from the square to another district, Silvia stops, checks her surroundings, and looks directly at %s.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Do you have time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you, Silvia?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'm on my break, so yes. Let's talk. I've heard so much about you, %s. I wondered who you were. Now we finally meet.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: If you've met Argent, did he mention me? Did he say I never listen to him again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... He just said he had a younger sister.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Haah... So he did. He definitely did. Anyway, since Dayna sent you, let me introduce myself properly. I'm Silvia, a scribe at the Imperial Archives.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Archives? A scribe?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: You must be from elsewhere if you don't know the Archives. Most people outside Glaston wouldn't know about us or our scribes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Yes. We're a small institution with few staff. Every day, we record events in the Empire in books, magical devices, and so on.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: We've existed since the Kingdom of Silvaria became an empire. Quite a long time.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: As a scribe, I keep written records by hand. I'm at the very bottom of the ranks, but I find it interesting. I enjoy it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! Would the Archives have maps of LaChouette's waterways, or records of paths into them?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Of course. That must be what Dayna meant when she asked me to help you, %s.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: But keep this from Argent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: He'll ask why I didn't tell him I was working for the princess. The moment Dayna is involved, his questions never end.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: He'll find out eventually. What matters is who tells him. If it's Dayna or Her Majesty, that's fine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But if it's me or anyone else, you'll get a lecture?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Yes... He nags so much. My friends' brothers don't act like that. Ugh, enough about Argent.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'll look for records on Glaston's underground waterways.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Silvia.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Do you know Daisy, by any chance?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I met her through Moran when I went to LaChouette. I saw her perform in the street, too.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Then tomorrow, once I've sorted out my work, I'll meet you where she was performing.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Wait there around this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Silvia.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: If you really want to thank me, buy me a gelato sometime. See you tomorrow, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Silvia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm. There's nothing more I can do today. I should rest. Narsha's inn was this way, wasn't it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Things seem to be going rather smoothly...

steps.name: The Sewers beneath the Slums
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Narsha] in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」, then approach 「Daisy」's location to meet [Silvia]. Enter 「LaChouette Slums」 and meet 「Licota」.
2. Defeat [Ratsy] in 「LaChouette Slums」, then turn in the quest to [Licota] in 「LaChouette Slums」.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I didn't know you'd be staying here, too. Is your work taking a while?
(Munching on a piece of bread from the inn, Narsha steps outside with the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's still time, so it's fine. Didn't you take care of your business yesterday?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Raven sent someone, so I thought we'd go straight away. But he asked me to wait a day. I just lazed around my room.
(Narsha takes a small bite of bread and smiles happily.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Good food always lifts my spirits.
(A man wearing glasses waves to them from a distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, do you know him? He seems to be greeting us.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, Raven?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: ...Narsha. It's been a while...
(A pale mage approaches Narsha, looking utterly exhausted.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Did you stay up all night again?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: ...I found an intriguing book... How did you know I'd been up all night?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You look incredibly tired.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: As observant as ever, Narsha. ...It's this book. It describes a new power within darkness—
(The mage called Raven holds up a book. As he begins to explain it, his eyes meet %s's.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: You have company. Oh, hello. I'm Raven, a mage with the Magic Bureau. If I may ask your name...
(Narsha suddenly pushes Raven from behind.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You said you were busy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Narsha? I came to see you, and I heard the food here was good, so I thought I'd... Mmph, mmph!
(Producing what looks like one of Jelic's cakes, Narsha stuffs it straight into Raven's mouth.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is delicious, too. I'll go with Raven now. See you later.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Mmph, mmph.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Take care.
(Narsha hurriedly drags Raven out of LaChouette.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's trying to spare me unnecessary contact with the Bureau's mages...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that song... ?
(A familiar song rings out from one side of LaChouette.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daisy's singing? She's performing again today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's head that way...
(A dazzling guitar passage gives way to Daisy's clear voice, filling one corner of LaChouette.)
(Passersby who had dismissed the idea of a performance in the slums stop in their tracks when they hear her.)
(As the song ends, cheers rise from every side.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: We love you, Daisy! Daisy outshines every flower!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: You're calling me a flower, not a pig, right? Your Pop'n Star, Daisy!
(After a quick remark, Daisy launches into the next song, just as energetic as the last.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's incredible... I don't know how to describe it...

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Like a clear glass marble rolling along, right? A sturdy one that keeps rolling forever! Then it bounces so high! All the way to the sky!

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: And when it falls, it lands right in my heart...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about, Silvia?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Someone who sings with such a beautiful voice is also so pretty and cute! Even her smallest gestures are adorable... Wow...

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Daisy is, I mean. So...
(A small smile blooms on Silvia's face as she talks about Daisy.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I was worn out by my brother's nagging and standing in the square, staring into space. Then I heard this heavenly voice.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I thought, 'This is it! The goddess has blessed me!' So I followed the sound...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look happy, Silvia.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Sorry. I lose my head whenever Daisy comes up.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Here are the records you asked for. A map of the alleys leading to LaChouette's waterways, plans of the waterways themselves...

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Since you mentioned the waterways, I looked for related records, too. I found an account of the knights' confrontation with the murderer Gentleman and copied it down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Silvia. Wait...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You copied all of this? And drew the maps?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Copying text and drawings is my job, so I managed. It's a shame I'm only allowed to consult the originals.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it, Silvia?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: If I ask whether it's dangerous, you'll say no, won't you? My brother always does.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: So just... don't get hurt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Daisy's performance is over, so I should go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Take care, Silvia.
(Silvia says goodbye with a small smile and hurries up to the square.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a lot of material. Let's take a look...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The account of Gentleman is much the same as what Manuel told me. Was that his name? But why are these waterway plans so complicated? Ah, here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ('Current maintenance access to LaChouette's waterways is from the north. Southern access is closed after prolonged disuse,' it says.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The children went down through the north. I'll try the south.)
(As %s starts toward the alley marked on the map and plans, someone catches their clothes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: %s, I can sense magic where you're headed. Wait a little before you go.
(Looking up, the adventurer sees shadows spreading from the alley, where none were visible a moment before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (These shadows... The Other Side?)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Sometimes there's a brief tremor from the administrative district, where the Magic Bureau is. Like a little earthquake. It's caused by tangled currents of magic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know about that, Daisy?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: I graduated from Jerenis Magic Academy! My grades weren't great, but I know that much.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: The teachers said the Bureau has powerful magical devices that can make the flow of magic suddenly surge.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: They said it wasn't dangerous, but magic is never completely safe, is it?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: It fades quickly, so they told us to wait until it's gone before passing through.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Daisy.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Oh, %s. One moment!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Should I mention this... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daisy? It's all right. Tell me.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Well... At some point, magic began to gather in LaChouette instead of dispersing. Normally it should fade quickly, but it stayed.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: It was strange. Not a gentle current, but dense clumps spread all over LaChouette. Strong enough that I couldn't stop noticing them.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: So I kept filing complaints with the Magic Bureau, asking them to do something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: They tried to dismiss it as nothing, so I kept protesting. Maybe they were concerned because I studied at the academy. They eventually sent mages to do something...

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: But hardly anything changed. How long are they going to keep treating LaChouette this way... ?

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: In the end, I paid to make a whole lot of magical tools myself.
(Daisy presses a handful of things into %s's hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stickers? Oh, with your face on them.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Cute, right? They're affordable to make and feel like proper merchandise. Easy to stick anywhere, too.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: The people of LaChouette and my fans put them up everywhere, and the magic seems to be dispersing a little. Only a little, though...

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: If I perform more often, make more stickers, and keep putting them up, perhaps that strange magic will finally clear out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, so that's what's been happening.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Huh? Are the stickers working better? A lot more magic has dispersed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It should be safe to go now, right? Daisy, I'll put up a few more as I walk through the alley, just in case.

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Would you? Thank you, %s! I'm counting on you, %s!
(Seeing Daisy give stickers to %s, people in the distance flock over.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Aaaaah, wait! Someone get my manager! Manager! Oh, right. I don't have one. Form a line, please!

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Daisy will hand out the stickers herself!
(At her words, the milling crowd forms an orderly queue. It seems long enough to reach the central square.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You really are popular, Daisy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No time to stand around. Let's enter the alley and see what's there.)
(The moment the adventurer steps into the alley, the lingering shadows scatter an unfamiliar darkness and vanish.)
(Beyond the darkness, LaChouette's familiar streets feel profoundly different.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No one's here. Is this the Other Side...? Ugh, what's that smell?
(An unusually foul stench stings the nose. Instinctively, a hand rises to cover mouth and nose.)
(When the smell seems to have faded, the adventurer lowers their hand. But an unpleasant trace still lingers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...This isn't an ordinary sewer smell. If it fills the Other Side, then it must be coming from beneath the waterways...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should check the route again before—
(As %s starts to unfold Silvia's records, someone appears before them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico? What are you doing here... ?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...I wondered who it was. It's you, %s.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'll guide you there. I'll explain once we arrive. Until then, anything that stands in our way...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...Is an enemy. Beings from an unknown world that regard us as foes.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: They seem even more alert now that you've arrived, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Follow me.

steps.name: Lifting the Veil
steps.objective: Talk to [Licota] in 「LaChouette Slums」, then turn in the quest to [Parmila] in 「LaChouette Slums」.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Here.
(Licota leads the way to a corner of an alley. Farther in, a large manhole cover stands half open.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's the way into the underground waterways. Thank you, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You won't be able to enter straight away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Something like an invisible barrier is covering the entrance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...
(As Licota said, something blocks the adventurer's approach and pushes them back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're right. What do we do?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There must be a way down somewhere in this space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll have to look. But Rico...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I was just about to explain.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: After we last parted, %s, I discovered this place while passing through Glaston on my way elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You know the man called Baral, so I'll be direct. I was following him on the President's orders, but lost him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I recently saw him in Vayuna Canyon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Licota what happened with Baral in Vayuna Canyon.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...He went there and did all that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you tell me a little more, Rico?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Of course, %s.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Given his history, we were already watching him. He was visiting one Other Side after another across Freios.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: He's been to several of them already.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Then I saw him heading for Glaston and followed. That's how I found the Other Side that had remained hidden until now.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Why couldn't I see Glaston's Other Side before? If it were ordinary, I should have discovered it long ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems to be under the control of something beyond human...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: What? Wait. I need a moment to take that in...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Then the reason I couldn't find the Other Side, and the reason I lost Baral...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: He was looking for something in these streets. Could that be connected?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Probably. I think what Baral wants is power.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Power?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Power beyond humanity. He chose to become evil to obtain it.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: How foolish.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: He must have come here because of something a Bureau mage told him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A mage?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Baral met a mage outside the Magic Bureau... Oh, %s. Someone's coming. Shh. Quiet.
(At Licota's signal, they hurry behind a building. The voices of two people walking past reach them, quiet but clear.)

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: Commander, is this the place?

lines.speaker: 소녀의 목소리
lines.text: This way should be right.

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: We came on the word of a demon who makes those strange squawking noises... But what's wrong with this place? It's clearly LaChouette. Why are there monsters?

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: Perhaps we should be grateful the monsters aren't noticing us.

lines.speaker: 소녀의 목소리
lines.text: Shh. Quiet. Keep talking, and I'll throw you in among them.

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: I'll be quiet.

lines.speaker: 소녀의 목소리
lines.text: You trust me, don't you?

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: ...I followed you because I do.
(As the pair moves away, their conversation fades beyond hearing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've heard those voices before...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Let's follow them, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they've come into the Other Side like this, they can't be here on ordinary business...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There are more enemies ahead. Be careful. I'll lead.

steps.name: A Place Preparing for Destruction
steps.objective:
1. Finish talking to [Parmila] in 「LaChouette Slums」, then defeat [Gnosis] inside 「Boundary of the Void」.
2. Go outside and turn in the quest to [Parmila] in 「LaChouette Slums」.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Here, Callone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: An abandoned house... Whether it holds anything, as that demon claimed, I can't say.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There must be something. Almost everything Daniel has told us has been right.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Giving us better information than most humans, so readily...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: He's safe in Invernel now. That's what matters.
(Parmila approaches the abandoned house, which looks ready to collapse. She raises her head and murmurs.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Could the boss be here... ?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone?
(At Callone's startled words, Parmila turns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you two doing here... ?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, aren't these two...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know them, too, Rico? Commander Parmila and Callone, of the Oscuras Mercenaries.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Callone, from the private magic research institute...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don't know how you know that, but that's my past...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You never received a dismissal notice. Technically, you still work there.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Well, yes... On paper.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You're still on assignment, so if anything happens to the mercenaries, you can step back for a while.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Commander, how can you say that? Do I look so heartless to you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, don't fight...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We're not fighting, %s.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: We're not fighting!

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I heard you say the demon's information was accurate. What were you looking for?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's a long story. Want to hear it too, Moonlight member?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You know about Moonlight as well. Then let's hear it.
(Parmila explains to Licota and %s why she came here.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And that's why we're here.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Let me sort this out. Parmila, you can see what others can't see, hear what they can't hear, and find what they can't find?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, exactly. And I'm not a witch or anything, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Of course...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Before you met %s... More precisely, before you became involved with Callone, you intended to live quietly as the mercenaries' commander.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: But too many coincidences piled up for you to stay put. You and Callone started looking for clues...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: And that brought you here. Correct?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, exactly. Heh, you're good at summing things up, Moonlight friend. Along the way, we found a witch, too.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: For some reason, I felt I should tell you about her, %s. You two have a similar air about you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hilda...)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: A pretty man came to see me once and paid me to find a witch on the run. A very pretty man...? Oh, wait...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No, was it a woman with rabbit ears...? Who was it? Callone, do you remember?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I'm afraid I don't...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We're always together. How can you not remember?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Daphne could easily do that.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The funny thing is, I was supposed to give the witch a choice if I found her.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Come with us, or keep running.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: An offer no one would be likely to accept...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, she didn't come. And when she refused, the commission was automatically canceled.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If she had agreed, where would you have taken her?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ahaha, I don't know. I can't remember. At least I haven't forgotten the important part.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'm looking for someone. Not just one person, either. Many people have vanished from everyone's memories.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Only a handful of us remember.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Why is there a world where I remember them, but everyone else has forgotten...? Haah...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, I heard about the incident in Orcarium and thought I might find something there. The Bureau's mages couldn't have been killed for no reason.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's where I met Daniel, the demon reporter. Squawk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, the reporter from Monthly Rosengarten?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, the parrot reporter. I told him to give me information if he wanted to live. He had some good stuff.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You know some of it already, don't you, %s? About the witches. One witch is gathering the others...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And Aaron, the council chairman, wants to use them...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: And the place the missing people went is somewhere in Glaston.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: He's a demon, so I was suspicious. I checked a few things he told me. They were all true.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I met people who were the only ones to remember someone who vanished. Their stories confirmed his information.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: He said, 'Something's strange about that abandoned house in LaChouette, squawk. I haven't gone in. Could be dangerous, squawk.' So here we are.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: He said even a weak demon has the advantage of entering places like this easily.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...Devils and demons can enter the Other Side naturally. So can I, having been affected by the Twisted Shadow...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The Other Side... An unfamiliar concept, but I think I understand.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Since we're all here, let's go in together. You two have a reason for coming, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We followed you here, actually...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: What do you think, %s? If the parrot reporter's information is accurate, there may be something here...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Three is better than two, and four is better than three, right?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Please join us, %s. I have a feeling the commander is about to cause trouble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...All right. Rico and I were looking for a way into the blocked waterways anyway. This place might hold the answer.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thank you, %s. We won't follow you into the waterways.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'll take the lead. Follow me. %s will guard the rear.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: We're in your hands, Licota.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Just call me Rico.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thank you, Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's prepare properly before going in...)
(The four push open the house's half-closed door and enter one by one.)
(As the adventurer steps in last, an intense light rushes toward them, painfully bright.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, so bright...
(Both arms rise to shield the face, but the fierce light presses on. A few more steps bring an uncanny silence, as though no one else is there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is everyone all right?
(There is no sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico? Rico!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila! Callone! Anyone, answer me!
(Lowering their arms, the adventurer finds the light gone, leaving only deep darkness. Nothing can be made out in the silent space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looked like an ordinary house inside... Huh?
(As %s takes a single step forward, their body tips, falling endlessly into a depth with no floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah! I'm falling!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Falling like this, I should hit the ground with a huge crash...)
(The sensation of falling ceases, and %s's tightly shut eyes open.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this... ?
(Glaston fills the view, bathed in yellow light, yet somehow different from the city the adventurer knows.)
(An inverted Glaston hangs above. Below, another Glaston sheds debris as though it, too, has been overturned.)
(The two cities face each other, one above and one below. The world's uncanniness weighs heavily on the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Another world? Am I alone here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico! Parmila! Callone!
(No amount of searching or shouting brings an answer. Only %s stands in this strange world.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No one... Where am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
(At %s's words, a great flame rises among the ruins ahead.)
(The flame gradually takes human form, conjuring spheres of many-colored light around itself. It slowly approaches %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is it saying? That thing is clearly...)
(The being born from the flame strokes a sphere and quietly studies %s.)
You will hear me clearly now. I am speaking the language of Etoile. Are you the visitor who has entered this boundary?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Boundary? Who are you?
You know nothing of this place? Then I shall explain.
This space awakens at the wish of one who desires destruction. It has appeared in worlds beyond Etoile and reduced all things to nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?
Visitors from other worlds came here to protect their worlds. They believed this place held the means devised by the one who wished for destruction.
They endured and endured, trying to save their worlds. Yet they died imprisoned here, watching those worlds perish.
Life and death. Destruction and continuance. In the boundary between those moments, a visitor's death becomes their star's end.
Thus the fate of destruction harbored by that star reaches the end of eternity.
Then I, Gnosis, return to sleep. When the history of destruction begins upon another star, I approach and await its visitor.
That concludes my explanation.
(The being that called itself Gnosis steps back and regards the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I'm this visitor?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: You understand quickly, perhaps because you have escaped destruction's grasp so many times. Visitor from Etoile.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I, Gnosis, wish you to do nothing here. Feel your helplessness. Watch this boundary fade, and fall asleep.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: A visitor who endures will witness the end of a star they never wished to see.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: A world burned to nothing by a rain of fire. A world swept away by raging waves covering its land. A world swallowed as the earth splits in two.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: What destruction do you desire?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who would want their world destroyed?! Do you hear yourself?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: There are those who do. That is why I, Gnosis, am here. Etoile shall shatter...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop! I don't want to hear it!

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: A being from a world filled with absence cannot leave this perfect boundary. No visitor has ever escaped.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will escape! I have to! I have too much to do to stay here!

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Is that so? You wish that strongly to leave the Boundary of the Void?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: However much you have to do, it ends here. Regrettable, but I, Gnosis, wish the visitor to accept everything.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: But visitor %s... Your world? Has it already... ?
(The colored spheres circling Gnosis stop. One by one, they merge into it, forming a great flame.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What about my world?! Keep talking nonsense, and I'll...

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I, Gnosis, have something to verify concerning visitor %s. Do you also wish to know what it is?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: In that case...
(Now a great flame, Gnosis watches the ruins of broken buildings rise into the air.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Find me, Gnosis, somewhere within this boundary. Until then...
(With those words, Gnosis's flame flies toward the distant horizon and disappears.)
(Beings that were invisible before begin to reveal themselves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You won't get what you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a reason to live... To keep living. If only for that reason...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to get out of here.
(The destructive energy pouring over the visitor to the Boundary of the Void slowly fades. At its center stands the being that issued the challenge.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gnosis.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: You have come, visitor %s. I, Gnosis, shall say it again.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I wish you to do nothing here. Feel your helplessness. Watch this boundary fade, and fall asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has anyone who came this far ever chosen that?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I believe not. They fought me, Gnosis, to the end and died. Writhing in agony, they watched their worlds disappear.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I offer this so you may forget even that suffering.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Enough. What did you want to find out about me? You told me to come if I wanted to know.
(Gnosis gazes quietly into the distance, then raises an orb into the air.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Visitor %s, who has refused my offer. You will learn it if your will surpasses mine, the ruler of this space. If you defeat me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So it comes to that...

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: You will never learn.
(The surrounding lights flow into Gnosis's orb. It turns black and begins to radiate an ominous power.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Before you do, the abyss will swallow everything...
(The blackened orb crumbles like dust. Gnosis, trying to fill it with another power and set it in motion, stops.)
(After examining the orb, Gnosis reaches out. An unknown force binds %s's feet as they prepare to attack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what... ?
(The Boundary of the Void slowly loses its light around %s. Gnosis rises into the air, surveying its surroundings and %s.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I sense them in your will. Those who fell while watching the worlds they loved perish...

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: They are gone, but their wills remain, helping the next visitor who enters to avert a fate of destruction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know who you are, but thank you for fighting beside me...)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Their wills are with you. Thus they have blocked the power of Gnosis, ruler of this space.
(Gnosis's flames scatter on the wind across sky and ground, taking hold of everything except the visitor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: You will know when I, Gnosis, become ash. First, I shall cleanse this space, where their wills linger, with fire.
(At Gnosis's words, the flames begin consuming everything around them. Everything except %s.)

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I, Gnosis, do not die. I merely disappear from this moment. When another moment of destruction comes, I shall awaken and return.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I came to this star recently, but could not reach it. You pushed back the moment of destruction then as well.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: I might have appeared as a space called Purgatory.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. This is what that old man wants, too, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Escaping this space is not the end. Your star's fate of destruction endures forever, trapped in the endless cycle he created.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Even after I, Gnosis, depart, the force of destruction will remain and awaken.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: Pleroma, a world of ruin formed from all the emptiness humans gathered within themselves. And the demon god Demiurgos, sleeping inside it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The demon god Demiurgos?

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: A demon god who denies all living things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. I'll have to face it, then.

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: This version of you is indeed unusual. The you I met in another time screamed at the sight of destruction...

lines.speaker: 그노시스
lines.text: A pity. I shall have to wait to see that side of you. Farewell.
(The surrounding flames swell and surge like waves.)
(Before the visitor can react, they rise impossibly high and engulf everything.)
Thud.
(Something enormous seems to fall with a crash, but %s can see nothing.)
(An outstretched hand searches the surroundings, finding nothing to feel.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What did Gnosis do to me?
(A familiar-looking figure slowly approaches from the distance.)
Haah... Haah...
I have to leave. I have to get out...
(A girl runs here and there, carrying an umbrella.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That child... From the memory between the Great Wall, before I came to Glaston...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante... ?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Who? Where are you? Who's calling me?
(Hearing %s's voice, Atalante looks around.)
(She wanders in confusion, then stops.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Did you think I wouldn't find you there? What are you doing?
(Atalante stands directly before %s and meets their gaze with an inscrutable smile.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I can't see you from here, but I can feel you. You'll come find me, won't you? You'll let me out?
(A black shadow falls behind Atalante.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: The boundary is broken. Pleroma is open. So get me out of here.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Otherwise, everyone will die...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: No. I'll kill everyone!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this child saying?)
(Atalante suddenly covers her mouth with both hands, horrified.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: No, that wasn't me. That's not me. I don't say things like that. I... I just want to see Mommy.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: So... So find me and let me out. I won't do anything else. I... I...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: AAAAAAAH!
(At Atalante's scream, the darkness blocking %s's sight vanishes. Her figure within it scatters and disappears, too.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante's gone... She seemed so unstable...
(With Gnosis gone, the Boundary of the Void stands motionless, as though removed from the flow of time.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's still here, even with Gnosis gone... How do I leave?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, over there...)
(A small light of unknown origin shimmers around %s.)
(Almost entranced, the adventurer follows it. The distorted city gradually dissolves.)

steps.name: A Place That Calls to the Adventurer
steps.objective: Talk to [Parmila] in 「LaChouette Slums」, then turn in the quest to [Licota] in 「LaChouette Slums」.

lines.text: (Parmila's sudden voice startles the adventurer into looking around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila! Where's Callone? Rico!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Shh, be quiet. You'll bring those things down on us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm back...)
(Behind Parmila stands the abandoned house they entered earlier.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Are you all right, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. But I don't see Callone...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: He's resting over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The moment we entered, the darkness seized us and pulled us into separate rooms.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We saw Glaston above us, just like the one beneath our feet. Everything was being drawn up into the inverted city. A world like that...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We all saw the same thing. A vision? An illusion? I don't know what to call it...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I saw you fighting a monster and dying, %s. I tried to fight beside you, but I... I was helpless...
(The adventurer quietly takes Licota's trembling hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Rico.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Everyone was dying at the monster's hands. The world burned, then darkness came and swallowed everything...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Just as I thought it was over, a brilliant light appeared. It was so bright I closed my eyes...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: And suddenly, we were back outside the house.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I thought we'd never see you again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Callone all right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: He's a little shaken.
(Where Parmila looks, Callone sits with a vacant expression, as though his soul has left him.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: He'll be all right...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That... monster...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: What happened to it, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain Gnosis to Licota and Parmila. Their faces grow grim as they listen.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's good that the wills of people from destroyed worlds helped us. But what the Magic Bureau has been secretly creating is right beneath us...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's so absurd, I'm speechless.
(Parmila bows her head and bites her lip.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: ...I only wanted to find someone I owed so much to. I only wanted to know why these terrible things were happening, so I could escape them...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Why is this happening?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila, none of us is to blame.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I know. Who could I blame? The villains, of course.
(Forcing a smile, Parmila takes %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thank you, %s...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s and I will find a way to deal with this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But the Boundary of the Void still seems to be there. What should I do... ?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You mean...
(Licota peers through the house's open door. She sees only an empty interior strewn with household clutter.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We checked the house again, and there was nothing... But that space is still there for you, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It seems so.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ah, I don't understand. Listen, %s.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone and I are ordinary humans. I don't think we can help. I'm sorry. We'll return to our own world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will you be all right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Don't worry. We made it here safely, so we can make it back. I am the commander of the Oscuras Mercenaries, after all.
