(Parmila points a thumb at herself with a confident expression.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There's no time to lose. Go to that place where the demon god, or whatever it is, has awakened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Parmila. Come on, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You two, get back safely.
(After practically shooing them away, Parmila looks at Callone sitting in the corner.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, snap out of it. They're gone.
(At her words, Callone's usual expression returns. He approaches Parmila and checks their surroundings.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I didn't think you'd be that convincing.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Phew. I was trying to survive. I thought back to when you pushed me into a monster's nest to look for a cat...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Though I think Licota noticed...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Your acting was terrible, but it did the job.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You gave the signal, so I pretended to know nothing and acted dazed. What now?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Our squawking friend's information wasn't necessarily wrong.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Commander?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's find our own way there.

steps.name: A False Space
steps.objective:
1. Finish talking to [Licota] in 「LaChouette Slums」, then defeat [Atalante] inside 「Pleroma」 and obtain the <Mirror of Shallow Memories>.
2. Go outside and turn in the quest to [Licota] in 「LaChouette Slums」.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, the barrier is gone. We should be able to enter.
(Licota lowers the hand she extended to test the barrier and approaches %s, who is staring at the manhole.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that it's time to go in, I'm a little afraid. I thought I'd prepared myself...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Shall we rest a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm all right. Let's go.
(Licota quietly nods and pushes the half-closed manhole cover aside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Rico. Let's head down.
(The long descent down the ladder passes through darkness so complete it seems the abyss has swallowed everything.)
(At last, solid ground replaces the precarious rungs beneath their feet. The darkness slowly lifts, revealing an unfamiliar sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this... Pleroma?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It seems to be the place that creature Gnosis named. But that little girl...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A child wandering where a demon god has awakened...)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, someone's over there.
(Licota indicates a distant figure with a nod. As she raises her lance, it appears before them in the blink of an eye.)
(Licota hastily swings her lance, but the figure steps lightly back, untroubled.)
Welcome, my friends. You have come unbidden to Pleroma, abode of the demon god.
The divine one will be pleased. How long it has been since I witnessed that sacred power...
(A man in a yellow suit murmurs in ecstasy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
(At %s's question, he toys with his mustache and sneers.)
I no longer recall the name I bore as a human. Now I follow the power and authority of the one who shall become a new god...
Call me Mr. Demonic for now. Weak humans once called me the murderer Gentleman, I believe. But I never cared for that name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gentleman...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The killer who murdered Glaston's citizens every night, decades ago...
(Seeing Licota and %s take defensive stances, Mr. Demonic nods.)

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: You know me well. Commendable. That doesn't mean I'll let you leave.

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: From the moment you came down here, you became offerings to the divine one. How many sacrifices have I made already? I can scarcely remember.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You killed those people for the demon god?

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: The day is almost here! The day the divine one fully awakens and devours the world!

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: We'll have to take him down first.

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Hehe. You think you can defeat me... Wait. You are...
(Smiling faintly, Mr. Demonic reaches into the shadows. He draws out a huge pair of sharp scissors, which separates into two blades in his hands.)

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: I don't know how you obtained such a blessing... But I am both envious and furious. How I wish to pierce your heart myself...

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Yet the divine one wishes to see you, so I shall refrain for now.
(Mr. Demonic puts away his scissors and turns.)

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: The road to the divine one will not be easy. Remember that I, too, stand upon it. Best of luck.
(With that, Mr. Demonic vanishes. They hurry to pursue, but someone running toward them makes them stop.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante?
(Umbrella in hand, Atalante runs past Licota and %s.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: You came, %s. But where are you? I can hear your voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. I never told you my name...
(Atalante meets %s's eyes and gives an inscrutable smile.)
(Then she disappears as though nothing has happened. Sensing something wrong, Licota pursues her, only to be forced back by an unknown power.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: She won't let us follow her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You knew that girl, didn't you? Please tell me who she is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...
(Licota's expression hardens as she listens.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: %s, we think we came here of our own will. But someone else's will may be involved.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: As that monster said, the one who desires this world's destruction must be involved. But they wouldn't act directly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So if a demon god has awakened to act in their place... Oh, no...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Learning your name would have been easy, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was hoping that wasn't it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We have no choice. Rico...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, but...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I know what you're going to say, %s. But I am a knight who walks the twisted darkness. I came here to fulfill my duty.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Our paths merely happen to coincide for a while, %s.
(Licota starts to walk ahead of %s, then stops.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The being awakened in Pleroma seems to be waiting for you to lead, %s. It's blocking my steps...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: No, I'm sorry. I was hasty.
(When Licota steps behind %s, a breeze begins to blow from the distance, carrying an unfamiliar scent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What's that smell?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Spellbooks smell like that when magic burns or vaporizes them. Usually it's too faint to notice...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much magic did they use...? Phew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We need to hurry, Rico. I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes. I'll watch your back.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I can't believe a place like this exists beneath Glaston...
(The strange place at the end of the waterway is nothing like the splendid city above.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd believe it if someone called this a cave.
(Great pillars line the cavernous path, with crystals formed of magic tied or suspended beside them.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: They hold magic, so you could call them magic stones. But they're clearly different from the ones the demigod Weiss used.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: They don't seem to have been made from living beings...
(As they examine their surroundings, they meet the eyes of someone watching from the other side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I've waited so long. You came to let me out, right? Right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Me? Atalante... Who else would I be... ?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I mean... I... Who am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I don't know. I woke up here. The mages prepared this place for something important. They said they'd let me out when the time came...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: But they just said it failed and left me here. They're horrible men.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: When that nameless child went outside, I should have gone, too. But I listened to the men. And now look...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: You got in here, %s, so take me out. Please...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A nameless child? Wait, No Name?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: You know No Name? How do you know him? Let me guess!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: He went to Orcarium, or whatever it's called, to get a god's power, right? You met him there? Then I think he went with a demon called the Grand Duke...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know all that?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I don't know. I just knew. %s, let me out. I won't ask you to save me. If you just let me leave...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I won't kill you.
(Atalante looks shocked by her own words. When the pair tense, she waves her hands in denial.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: ...N-no. That wasn't me... I didn't mean it. I'm sorry. I was wrong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante... What do you want me to do?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I don't know. I... I...
(Atalante looks around anxiously, then recoils at the sight of someone approaching.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Persistent, aren't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought we'd put him down for good...

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: You rats. How dare you humiliate me... Before you meet the divine one, I'll tear you—
(Mr. Demonic spots Atalante hiding anxiously behind a stone pillar and smiles.)

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: My god. You have awakened?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Why do you call me that, mister?

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: You shall awaken as a demon god and become ruler of the new world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A demon god...

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: The mages called you a failure, but I have never doubted you. That is why I offered you the power of life.

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: The future Crowley showed me is here. Hehe. It has taken so long. How many years has it been... ?

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Whenever you briefly awakened to judge the mages, I trembled with awe. Judge this beautiful, hideous world...

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Kill me and this god-blessed one before you, and claim us! Then you will be complete. Once you leave Pleroma...

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Hahahaha! Hahahaha! HAHAHAHAHA!
(Watching Mr. Demonic's ecstasy, Atalante quietly steps forward.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Mister...
(With a sharp sound, the umbrella in Atalante's hand pierces Mr. Demonic's heart.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante... ?

lines.speaker: 미스터 데모닉
lines.text: Nngh... As he desires, this star shall reach its end...
(Mr. Demonic clutches his chest in pain, but his face remains full of joy.)
(His figure distorts, then turns to dust with a thunderous sound. It scatters through Pleroma and vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wh-what did I just see...?)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Pull yourself together, %s. Something's wrong with Atalante.
(Having fulfilled Mr. Demonic's wish, Atalante suddenly collapses and screams.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: AAAAAAAH!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I didn't do that. I didn't want to do it. I... I just wanted to live...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I thought it was a dream. It wasn't me, so it had to be a dream. Did I only make myself believe that? Did I keep believing it even though I knew it was real?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Get out of me... What are you using me for? Have I been doing this to other people... ?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Is this all someone made like me can do?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: What about my memories of Mommy looking for me...? The Mommy I know?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Who was the me who played with spirits and friends in Creed? My name is Atalante...
(Atalante's eyes suddenly lose focus.)
(At a low voice, Licota covers her ears and collapses.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Aaaaah! Nngh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Licota? Are you all right?
(As the adventurer tries to reach the unconscious Licota, Pleroma distorts around Atalante.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Pleroma is my false world. Any life sustained by twisted darkness will lose its strength within this space.”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Such is my awakened will.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante, stop this now!

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Atalante...”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “...I am Atalante, and yet I am not. This name belongs to the project the mages created.”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Atalante, a god and a great warrior from another world. Did they create me in the hope that I would become a god as great as that warrior...?”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Then what am I to do?”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “...Ah, I remember. I must go outside, as Atalante wishes. Then Pleroma, which has harbored me, will burst and engulf the world in its influence.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't let you do that, Atalante...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “The girl made by human mages was merely a vessel bearing that name. I... I am...”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “The one who shall devour this world and become its new master... Demiurgos.”
(Atalante gives the wary %s a small smile and closes her eyes.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “Mortal of a world soon to perish...”
(At her words, a tremendous power shakes Pleroma.)
(It is like the moment of meeting a new god before, yet different. As the adventurer tenses, Atalante opens her eyes.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: “You shall vanish with Etoile, bearing despair, pain, and emptiness.”
(The message of the demon god Demiurgos, spoken through Atalante...)
(...Heralds Etoile's end.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “GAAAAAAH!”
(Demiurgos, the demon god awakened within Atalante, clutches an arm and screams under %s's attack.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Nngh... Why can I feel... pain...?”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haah... Haah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is so hard. Hold on. Just a little longer, and it'll be over... My vision's blurring...)
(Barely standing, %s sees the suffering demon god through a haze.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “You have no strength left to endure.”
(Still clutching its aching right arm, Demiurgos raises the umbrella. A huge sphere of water rises before it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I-I have to stop that. It's different from the last attack.)
(Noticing the adventurer approach, Demiurgos speaks softly.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Stop.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?
(Everything flowing through Pleroma stops. Everything except Demiurgos.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “It is over.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-no. This can't happen...
(Demiurgos watches the adventurer suffer, still fully conscious, then quietly raises an arm.)
(As it swings the umbrella to burst the water sphere, it suddenly screams in agony.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “GAAAAAAH!”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Why do you keep waking to interfere?!”
(Within the frozen Pleroma, Demiurgos writhes in Atalante's body, speaking to someone.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Atalante!”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Atalante?)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Now that I have awakened, this world is destined to perish. You know that. Why pretend otherwise?”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Stupid failure... It is simply what I must do. What you desire.”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “You only want to go outside? You don't want the world destroyed? Hahahahaha!”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Your refusal to desire it will not prevent what must happen.”
(Demiurgos tries again to burst the sphere with the umbrella, but its arm twists the wrong way.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “GAAAAAH! You wretched failure!”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “I should never have awakened in this vessel. Why did it have to be here...?”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Do not interfere, Atalante! I am you, and you are me!”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Those memories are not yours. They belong to the children of Creed who died over centuries. Created. Yes, even your memories were created. You are a fake.”

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “GAAAAAH!”
(Demiurgos suddenly clutches its head with both hands and screams.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Gaaaah... I... I am no fake. I am the demon god Demiurgos.”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: You said you're me.
(As Demiurgos screams, the ominous energy filling Pleroma drains away. Atalante's voice rings out through it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante... ?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: Demiurgos, if I'm a fake, then so are you. You already know that.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: You know how we were made... A false god created within an artificial vessel...

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “How dare you... You would restrain me? AAAAAH!”

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: ...You came here to save the world, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: ...Just now, I felt your heart. The hearts of living things. Everyone wants to live happily in this world. But they can't while I'm here.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: %s, don't let me out. Kill me here...

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “Atalante, stop.”
(The screaming Demiurgos approaches the sphere it created. The water expands and traps it inside.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “AAATAAAALAAANTE!”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haah... Haah... Atalante, what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: If you kill me, this false god will disappear, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “GAAAAAH!”
KRA-BOOOOM!
(Demiurgos unleashes an explosion of power inside the water sphere, shaking Pleroma again.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: Kill me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: It's all right. Just like the demon god inside me said, I... It's all my fault. I covered everything up by telling myself it was a dream...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: When I came to, someone would be dead or dying. I didn't want to believe it. So I called it a dream and trapped myself inside that dream.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: Even if the demon god within me did it, I was the one who did it.

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “GAAAAAH! ATALANTE!”
KRA-BOOOOM!
(Cracks begin to spread across the sphere imprisoning Demiurgos.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: There's no time. I can't hold Demiurgos much longer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. If that's the only way... Huh?
(With a familiar bright, clear ring, a silver coin rolls toward %s.)
(Pleroma shudders under a power unlike the demon god's.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You stood against me, yet you hesitate here. Ordinarily, you would have cut that demon god down already...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This time, I have come to inform you, not make an offer. I shall dispose of that demon god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos! Nngh!
(In the blink of an eye, Barbatos appears and seizes %s by the throat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nngh... B-Bar... batos... Ghh...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I like that stubborn look in your eyes. Save that strength. Show it to me when I become a god.
(Still holding the adventurer aloft, Barbatos takes their weapon, then throws them aside.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I'll borrow your weapon for a moment. It's more useful than mine for extracting a demon god's power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... Grand Duke...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Atalante, I intend to defeat the demon god in %s's place. Is that acceptable?

lines.speaker: 아탈란테의 목소리
lines.text: Yes. I'm ready...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Very well. I accept your wish.

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “GAAAAAH! I must get out!”
(Barbatos adjusts his glasses as he studies the water sphere. He raises both his gunblade and %s's weapon toward the struggling Demiurgos.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A god awakened in a space made by humans? A fraud, daring to covet the world I shall rule...
(With a faint smile, Barbatos plunges his gunblade into the sphere imprisoning Demiurgos.)

lines.speaker: 데미우르고스
lines.text: “GAAAAH!”

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Demiurgos, I, Barbatos, sincerely thank you for failing to become a true god.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And this star's despair belongs to me...
(With those words, Barbatos drives %s's weapon toward Demiurgos's heart.)
(The being that was a demon god gives a final scream, and a tremendous flash fills Pleroma.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It... hurts...)
(Lying fallen with eyes closed, %s slowly receives the memories of others.)
(Memories of the beastfolk Aaron and his soldiers captured in Creed, long ago.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Thank you for the loan.
(Barbatos tosses the weapon before the fallen %s and watches. He sneers as %s retrieves it and takes a defensive stance.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Attack me here, and everything you've worked for will collapse. Is that what you want?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: By all means, rage at your own helplessness and bury your guilt beneath it. Haven't I lightened that burden for you?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: In any case, the demon god is gone. Its empty shell will soon vanish, too. Say your goodbyes. Atalante is waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante?
(The figure of Demiurgos within the sphere raises its head and gazes in one direction.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I'm... sorry...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: I'm sorry... that this is all I can say...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I don't know what to say. Atalante, surely you...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: It's... all right... I'm only paying for what I did...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: ...It may... be strange... for me to say this... But next time... I want to be born... an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: Not something strange like this...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: ...So I can live... as myself...
(Atalante, who harbored the demon god, gradually fades. Parts of her body slowly turn to dust.)

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: ...I'm... sorry...

lines.speaker: 아탈란테
lines.text: ...I'm... sorry... I'll... go... now...
(With her final words, the sphere shrinks rapidly, seeming to swallow her scattering form, then vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atalante...
(Barbatos approaches %s, who stands hollow-eyed.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You cared about Atalante. These things happen everywhere.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This one happened here. And I have just resolved it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Humans are no different from gods. To fill the empty vessel of desire, they reach for things they know they should never touch.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Eventually, they succeed. But that stubbornness also creates a fate that makes everyone suffer. As you see here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hearing that from Barbatos of all people...)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Don't dwell on it, %s. The world is full of such things.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You have only a few tasks left. Eliminate Aaron, Lux's shadow. Discover what Daphne intends by gathering witches...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And face me again when I become this world's master. I don't imagine you'll have much time to rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough, cough. You never change, Grand Duke...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehe. I'll take that as a compliment. Oh, I nearly forgot. Do you think you can persuade the goddess Hecate?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Judging by the present situation, that seems unlikely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Very well. Now that the demon god is gone, the terrible future you saw should have vanished.
(Black butterflies appear and begin circling Barbatos.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I look forward to our next meeting. Until then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos! I'm not finished—
(The adventurer tries to seize him, but the butterflies have already spread into a vast veil and swallowed him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haah... Haah... He's gone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did Barbatos gain here? He keeps appearing. What is he planning? He said he would extract the demon god's power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A demon god's power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A demon trying to become a god... I should return and speak with Iris. It really is over, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...It seems to be over. Are you all right, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico! Rico, are you all right?
(Licota looks at %s, who has rushed over and seized both her hands in alarm.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm fine, but you, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. With everything happening in front of me, I couldn't look after you properly...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm sorry I couldn't help. All I could do was watch, lying there.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: When I came to, the barrier blocking me was gone... Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it, Rico?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: While you were down, %s, the Grand Duke took something from the demon god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?! Did you see what it was?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The flash was too bright. I couldn't see clearly. But I think that's why the power filling this place disappeared...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. Let's get out first... Huh?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing.
(Licota quietly follows %s's gaze. There is nothing but the aftermath of the battle.)
(A familiar-looking little brown bird flies over and settles on Licota's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: A bird?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid? No, a Sylphin?!
(The little bird flaps vigorously, as if to confirm it. Then it flies before them and looks in one direction.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We should go that way?
(The Sylphin chirps in a clear, sweet voice, as though saying yes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico, this bird is something like a spirit. Follow it, and we can get out.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: All right, Adventurer.
(Licota looks once more to the side, but sees nothing. They follow the Sylphin, seeking a way out of Pleroma.)
(A moment later, a human figure forms in the empty spot Licota and %s had been watching.)
(A red-haired man with glasses anxiously bites his nails, then looks down the path they took.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It wasn't time for Demiurgos to awaken... And why did B-Barbatos show up?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Damn it... Everything went wrong when No Name escaped. Haah, what do I do...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: ...Aaron will kill me. I still need more time to turn Narsha into a vessel...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: ...First, get out of here. I have to unseal every forbidden tome in the Magic Bureau. Perfect the vessel, quickly...

steps.name: La Vita
steps.objective:
1. Finish talking to [Licota] in 「LaChouette Slums」, then go to 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」.
2. Go to [Narsha]'s location in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」 and watch what happens, then turn in the quest to [Narsha].

lines.text: (Licota extends a hand, and the Sylphin quietly lands on it.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Thank you, little Sylphin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good work, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm sorry I couldn't do much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, you helped a lot. Ugh...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Are you all right?
(Licota catches the adventurer as their legs buckle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Just suddenly dizzy... A little rest should help...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: ...If only I were a little stronger...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel the same way. If only I were stronger... Oh, what will happen to the Other Side?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If I'm right, it will disappear soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because the demon god is gone?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Most Other Sides I've visited disappeared once the main cause was removed. There may be exceptions.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: With something as powerful as a demon god gone, those creatures from outside should soon vanish, too.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: And %s, you need to rest now. You look exhausted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haah... Haah... I'm fine...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The Sylphin says we should hurry out, too.
(The Sylphin flies to %s, catches their clothes in its beak, and tugs toward the way they came.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa, little Sylphin. All right. I understand.
(At %s's response, the Sylphin lets go.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'll support you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't have to...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I insist. Let's go to LaChouette's entrance together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you...
(Licota and %s follow the Sylphin flying ahead.)
(Leaving the ominous alleys of the Other Side behind, they see LaChouette's streets return. People reappear one by one.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: We're back. Where now? And where did the Sylphin go... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it went home, its work done. The inn is just farther in...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Why is it so noisy here? %s, look...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: The knights of the Scar of the Red Moon are over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be...
(As they look farther into the street, a middle-aged man approaches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Manuel?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: You've returned.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Just as Her Majesty said... She told us you'd arrive about now...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Both of you, follow me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Your Majesty, what do you mean... ?
(Narsha's ears perk up as she looks at Kaina, who is holding her hand.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Exactly what I said.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her Majesty came in person... Then...)
(Licota and %s step back to wait.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Narsha, you must not see Raven again. That is an imperial command.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Narsha, the knights are searching for him.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What? You don't mean...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I can't explain in detail, but Raven will bring you misery. So...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I will obey, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The knights will protect you for the time being. Please bear with any inconvenience.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you for looking after me. But %s, are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, Narsha. I just need some rest.
(Narsha looks between Argent and Kaina, then quietly steps back.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lord Manuel...

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You need no longer come to LaChouette on this matter. The concern that brought you here has been resolved.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: It can't be...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Again, I cannot explain in detail, but Gentleman has been destroyed... No, he brought about his own destruction.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I will obey, Your Majesty. But even apart from that, LaChouette...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I know of the redevelopment proposal you submitted through the council.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I'm honored, Your Majesty. It was my duty. My ancestors settled in LaChouette, the very roots of Glaston. I couldn't leave it as it is.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: My late father worked for its development, too. But the council...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You have persuaded the other nobles, Lord Manuel. The project will proceed smoothly.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Your Majesty? Chairman Aaron and the other nobles approved it?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: ...Yes.
(Manuel touches his forehead in disbelief. Meeting Kaina's gaze, he quietly nods.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You may return with confidence in me, Lord Manuel. Next time, I shall receive you in private.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.
(As Manuel withdraws, he looks at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: ...I don't quite understand, but was this your doing... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Oh, yes...
(Manuel nods in farewell to %s and leaves LaChouette.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s. Rico.
(Kaina catches Licota as she starts to kneel and helps her upright.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Your Majesty...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna told me. Well done.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It was hardly me, Your Majesty. %s did far more...
(Kaina approaches %s and takes both their hands.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, %s. The Empire... No. I, Kaina Dawn Silvaria, owe %s a debt I can never repay.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thanks to you, I no longer see that terrible future for Glaston.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: And I'm sorry... for making you bear that burden alone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did it, but somehow it doesn't feel properly finished. The Grand Duke...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Think only of the present, %s. As for the Grand Duke...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, did you see something else?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Well...
(A clear, hopeful voice rings out from somewhere in LaChouette.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What is that song?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daisy, a Pop'n Star from LaChouette. She sings for these streets.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: She seems to be famous.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Shall we listen for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty? There are so many people...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This much is fine. No dangerous individuals nearby...
(Accustomed to Kaina's impulsive behavior, Argent remains unruffled. Still mindful of his duty, he raises a hand.)
(Knights dressed like ordinary citizens emerge from the crowd and surround Kaina and her companions.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: That should keep Her Majesty out of sight from outside.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Argent, you needn't point out how short I am.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No, Your Majesty... That's not what I meant.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Hehe, I'm teasing. A Pop'n Star with a voice like that... Wonderful. Oh, Argent, Silvia is over there, too.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: AAAAH! Daisy! I'm yours!

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Ah... Silvia...
(Daisy finishes her first song and immediately starts the next. Recognizing it from the introduction, the crowd cheers with glowing faces.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: La Chouette La Vita... ♬

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: La Chouette La Vita... ♬ Eyes open, eyes closed, the merry owl dreams ♪ and sings ♩

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Don't try to lock me in a cage ♬
(Kaina gazes at Daisy as though spellbound.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Because we must keep living...
(Like Kaina, %s closes their eyes and listens to Daisy's clear, beautiful voice.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Kaina, you must keep dreaming as you live. That's what makes life worth living... So you mustn't give up...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh, %s. Come here a moment... No, I'll come to you.
(Kaina approaches %s, seemingly with something important to say, and whispers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Yes... Your Majesty. Understood.
(Amid the crowd's cheers, Daisy finishes her final song. She takes a sip of water, catches her breath, and beams at the audience.)

lines.speaker: 데이지
lines.text: Thank you, everyone! That's all for today. Look forward to the next show, and the next! Three, four! This has been Daisy!
(With Daisy's farewell, the warmth that stirred everyone's hearts fills LaChouette. It seems Glaston's troubles have ended...)
(But to the north, where Kaina's gaze rests, another future is taking shape. One no one has imagined.)
